machine.memory_topology_how: DERIVED: nvidia-smi names the card 'NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090'. NVIDIA's shared-memory parts are the Tegra/Jetson line and GB10, all matched above this; a GeForce, Quadro, Tesla, TITAN or datacenter part has its own board memory behind a PCIe link.
machine.arithmetic: DISCRETE: budget = 24,576 MiB board - 454 MiB desktop reserve(max, n=8, dated 2026-08-31) = 24,122 MiB. Hard wall 24,576 MiB = the board itself; past it the window spills over PCIe into host RAM, which is slow and survivable.
machine.spill_behaviour: over PCIe into host RAM: slow, survivable, and measurable -- which is exactly what makes the second ceiling and the collapse point findable

fully_resident_ceiling.why: the largest window that fits board minus the desktop reserve

shallow_safe_ceiling.why: a window allocated past the board stays fast until deep pages are touched

collapse_point.why: throughput falls off a cliff when the spill traffic crosses PCIe; measurable, and survivable enough to sweep to

fit.label: IQ2_M
fit.arithmetic: 3,687 weights + 2,318 drafter + 879 projector + 50 fixed state + 512 KV(c=16,384) = 7,446 MiB against a 24,122 MiB budget -> FITS.  Largest c that fits = (24,122 budget - 6,934 resident) MiB x 1,048,576 / 32,768 B per token = 550,000 tokens (drafter aboard), 624,185 with the drafter off.
fit.fixed_state_how: 50 MiB of context-independent state on 24 recurrent layers -- (conv_kernel 4 - 1) x (inner_size 4096 + 2 x group_count 16 x state_size 128) + state_size 128 x inner_size 4096 = 548864 elements x 4 B (f32). UNVERIFIED against this build: the profiler derived it from llama.cpp's tensor shapes, and a Stage-1 startup log settles it.
fit.kv_formula: KV values/token = 8 full-attn layers x 4 kv-heads x (key_length 256 + value_length 256) = 16384

rungs.step_rule: q = clamp(2^round(log2(ceiling/16)), 1,024, 16,384); lever = 2 rungs by halving below the dense band, snapped to q, floored at max(q, ceiling/8); dense = every q in [ceiling-2q, ceiling+4q]; coarse = every 4q from ceiling+8q to top; top = min(model context_length, 2x ceiling). Ceiling = the largest c whose arithmetic fits with the drafter aboard; it is optimistic (compute buffers are not in it), so rungs sit below it as well as above. The collapse point is BRACKETED, not resolved: scripts/arms/ctx-ceiling.json's stop_rule binary-refines at 4,096 resolution between the last good and the first bad rung.

per_file.step_rule: q = clamp(2^round(log2(ceiling/16)), 1,024, 16,384); lever = 2 rungs by halving below the dense band, snapped to q, floored at max(q, ceiling/8); dense = every q in [ceiling-2q, ceiling+4q]; coarse = every 4q from ceiling+8q to top; top = min(model context_length, 2x ceiling). Ceiling = the largest c whose arithmetic fits with the drafter aboard; it is optimistic (compute buffers are not in it), so rungs sit below it as well as above. The collapse point is BRACKETED, not resolved: scripts/arms/ctx-ceiling.json's stop_rule binary-refines at 4,096 resolution between the last good and the first bad rung.
per_file.why: THE WHOLE WINDOW FITS -- there is no ceiling to find. The arithmetic holds 550,000 tokens and the model was only trained for 262,144, so rule 13's fully-resident ceiling and shallow-safe ceiling are the same number, the model's own window, and this box has no collapse point for this file. A ceiling ladder here would spend a dozen arms proving one fact a dozen times. ONE rung, at the model's window -- still deep-filled to 90% of it, because rule 13 labels no window without a deep-fill probe near its top.

per_stage.basis: stages/stage-1.md: # Stage 1 -- STRUCTURE (~1 h, cheap probes only) (CITED, not scaled -- nothing countable to scale by)
stages/stage-2.md publishes ~1.5 h for the reference campaign's 2 ceiling arms = 45.0 min/rung; this plan derives 3 rungs -> 2.2 h
stages/stage-3.md publishes ~1 h across the reference campaign's 10 stage-3 arms; 10 survive this model's capability gate -> x1.00 -> 1.0-1.0 h
stages/stage-4.md publishes ~0.5 h for two probes at each of the reference campaign's 3 effort levels; this model's template offers 2 (True, False) -> x0.67 -> 0.3 h
stages/stage-5.md: # Stage 5 -- RECIPE LOCK (no GPU time -- the gate) (CITED, not scaled -- nothing countable to scale by)
stages/stage-6.md publishes ~6-10 h across the reference campaign's 11 stage-6 arms; 11 survive this model's capability gate -> x1.00 -> 6.0-10.0 h
